name: Patellar Chondromalacia / Patellar Chondral Lesion
definition: Softening, fissuring or focal damage of patellar articular cartilage, which may coexist with patellofemoral pain but should not be assumed to explain symptoms automatically.

investigations.principle: MRI can characterize cartilage when persistent symptoms or surgery planning justify imaging.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, cartilage, tendon, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Imaging cartilage changes must be correlated with symptoms before invasive treatment.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu-Sandhi cartilage phenotype may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Softening, fissuring or focal damage of patellar articular cartilage, which may coexist with patellofemoral pain but should not be assumed to explain symptoms automatically.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, severe deformity, progressive weakness, suspected tendon rupture, infection or other listed red flags.
